name: PNDbotics
summary:
PNDbotics develops humanoid robots, integrated actuators and the manufacturing capabilities needed to produce them. Its Adam platform is designed around human-like body structure and movement, while its PSA modular actuators provide a foundation for robot joints and motion control.

The company offers hardware configurations and development support for robot training, control and real-world data collection. Its PND-IMC manufacturing center connects research and design with production. This approach covers both complete humanoid platforms and important underlying components, supporting customers who need physical robots for developing, testing and deploying embodied AI.
